test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the capitalised word in the given sentence.

The fanatics are trying to OBSTRUCT the peace process.
solution:
The correct answer is Assist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'obstruct' is 'Assist'.
 
• Obstruct: to **stop something from happening **or somebody/something from moving either by accident or deliberately
 
• Meaning of the given options:
 
 
• Disrupt*: *to stop something happening as or when it should
 
• *Assist: **to help***
 
• Spoil: to change something good into something bad, unpleasant, useless, etc.; to ruin something
 
• Repress: to control an emotion or to try to prevent it from being shown or fel
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.​
